name: aws
notes: Official AWS command-line interface; Arch extra repo.

name: granted
notes: AWS access utility; the assume shell integration is provided by Granted.

name: aws-vault
notes: Stores AWS credentials in the OS keystore and injects temporary credentials into a subshell; Arch extra repo.

name: aws cdk cli
notes: Official AWS CDK Toolkit CLI; installs the cdk executable.

name: kubectl
notes: Kubernetes CLI; Arch extra repo (split package of kubernetes). kubeconfig and cluster access remain yours to configure.

name: Helm
notes: Kubernetes package manager; Arch extra repo.

name: k9s
notes: Terminal UI for Kubernetes clusters; Arch extra repo. Uses the kubeconfig already on the system; none is configured by this setup.

name: OpenTofu
notes: Open-source Terraform fork for infrastructure provisioning; Arch extra repo. State backends, providers, and credentials remain yours to configure.

name: stu
notes: Terminal UI explorer for Amazon S3: browse buckets/objects, preview, and download. No official Arch package; AUR package stu, maintained by orhun (same maintainer as the existing oxker entry). Uses whatever AWS credentials are already configured.

name: aws sam cli
notes: Official AWS SAM CLI; AUR package aws-sam-cli, actively maintained.

name: cfn-lint
notes: CloudFormation template linter; Arch extra repo package python-cfn-lint.

name: iamlive
notes: IAM policy generator; no official Arch or AUR package exists, so this pins the upstream project's own GitHub release Linux tarballs directly.

name: session-manager-plugin
notes: Official AWS Debian payload, extracted user-locally without maintainer scripts or host writes. The package declares only libc6; the command points directly to its relocatable Go executable, while systemd/upstart files in the payload are inert.

name: checkov
notes: Infrastructure-as-code security scanner; no official Arch or AUR package exists, so this installs the upstream PyPI release via uv.

name: gitleaks
notes: Secret scanner; Arch extra repo.

name: age
notes: File encryption tool; Arch extra repo.

name: actionlint
notes: GitHub Actions workflow linter; Arch extra repo.

name: ruff
notes: Python linter and formatter; Arch extra repo.

name: shellcheck
notes: Shell script static analyzer; Arch extra repo.

name: shfmt
notes: Shell formatter; Arch extra repo.

name: typos
notes: Source-code spell checker; Arch extra repo package is named typos.

name: mise
notes: Polyglot tool-version manager; Arch extra repo.

name: uv
notes: Python package and project manager; Arch extra repo.

name: Rust
notes: Arch extra repo formula providing rustc, cargo, and the bundled rustfmt/clippy tools. This is a single stable toolchain, not rustup; link it under rustup with `rustup toolchain link system /usr` or install rustup separately for toolchain channels and cross targets.

name: xh
notes: Friendly HTTPie-like HTTP client; Arch extra repo.

name: mkcert
notes: Local development CA tool; Arch extra repo. Running mkcert -install changes the local trust store and is never done automatically by this setup.

name: pnpm
notes: Fast, disk-space-efficient JS package manager; Arch extra repo.

name: yaml-py
notes: Matches the Mac setup's dedicated yaml-py helper: an isolated uv-managed Python interpreter with PyYAML importable, not the unrelated python-yq CLI.

name: tsc
notes: Official TypeScript package; installs the tsc compiler.

name: tsx
notes: TypeScript execution runtime from npm.

name: chezmoi
notes: Dotfile manager; Arch extra repo.

name: cheznav
notes: Chezmoi TUI published on PyPI; requires Python 3.14 or newer.

name: libreoffice
notes: Verified Flathub build of the LibreOffice suite; soffice is its command name, not a separate application.

name: imagemagick
notes: Image manipulation tools; Arch extra repo.

name: oxiping
notes: The requested oxiping spelling resolves to oxipng, the multithreaded PNG optimizer in Arch's extra repo.

name: jpegoptim
notes: JPEG optimizer; Arch extra repo.

name: caligula
notes: Official checksum-pinned Linux release executables avoid Caligula's bindgen, C compiler, and native compression-library source-build requirements.

name: chamber
notes: AWS SSM Parameter Store secrets CLI; AUR package chamber, not orphaned and unflagged for being out of date.

name: kitty
notes: Official checksum-pinned Linux binary bundle; extraction preserves Kitty's required directory layout and exposes kitty and kitten through wrappers.

name: bitwarden
notes: Officially verified Bitwarden desktop package on Flathub.

name: Posting
notes: Terminal HTTP client (Postman/Insomnia-like) built with Textual; requests are stored as plain YAML files. Installed as a uv tool, so it needs no desktop portal, Electron sandbox, or GUI launcher.

name: Fresh
notes: Terminal IDE: no-modes editing (Ctrl+S/Ctrl+C, mouse support), LSP, project search, magit-style git diff review, huge-file support, SSH remote editing, and a TypeScript plugin system. AUR package fresh-editor, maintained by the upstream author. Ships a built-in Dracula theme (select it in-app; the project's own philosophy is settings through its UI, not dotfiles, so this setup does not author a separate Dracula-Sakura variant). `fresh FILE` works as a drop-in $EDITOR/git core.editor.

name: gitlogue
notes: Animated Git history replay; Arch extra repo. Requires Git and a repository with commit history.

name: VisiData
notes: Terminal tabular-data explorer, exposed as vd and visidata. Arch extra repo provides the package; formats such as XLSX and Parquet need optional dependencies not provisioned by setup.

name: Herdr
notes: Terminal-native agent multiplexer: persistent panes for coding-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, OMP, etc.) that keep running in a background server across detach/reattach, SSH, and restarts, with per-agent status detection (OSC 7501). A different fit than Zellij's general-purpose splits/sessions: Herdr is purpose-built around supervising multiple running agents rather than general terminal multiplexing. AUR package herdr-bin (prebuilt binary, tracks upstream releases) is actively maintained; the source-build herdr package is unmaintained, so herdr-bin is preferred. Deploys a Dracula-Sakura color override (~/.config/herdr/config.toml); no accounts or remote machines are configured by this setup.

name: aerc
notes: Terminal email client (IMAP/SMTP/Maildir, PGP); Arch extra repo. Accounts, mail, and PGP keys remain yours to configure; does not import Thunderbird's accounts or provide calendar support.

name: ncdu
notes: Interactive disk usage analyzer; Arch extra repo. Complements duf (filesystem-level usage) by showing which directories consume space.

name: lnav
notes: Curses log file navigator with SQL-style querying across log files; Arch extra repo.

name: jless
notes: Interactive JSON viewer; Arch extra repo. Complements jq (which processes JSON) for browsing it.

name: bandwhich
notes: Terminal bandwidth monitor by process/connection; Arch extra repo. Reading network sockets may require running it with elevated privileges depending on kernel configuration; setup never does this for you.

name: procs
notes: Modern process viewer; Arch extra repo. Does not replace ps, which this setup leaves untouched.

name: duf
notes: Disk usage/free utility with a readable table layout; Arch extra repo. Does not replace df, which this setup leaves untouched.

name: dnsglobe
notes: DNS propagation TUI; AUR package dnsglobe, actively maintained. Requires outbound access to public DNS resolvers; no firewall or capability changes are applied.

name: oxker
notes: Container TUI; AUR package oxker, actively maintained. Speaks the Docker Engine HTTP API like lazydocker, so it needs `DOCKER_HOST` pointed at Podman's API socket (`systemctl --user enable --now podman.socket`, unprivileged, not enabled by this setup) to manage Podman containers.

name: llmfit
notes: Hardware-aware LLM recommendations; Arch extra repo. GPU detection depends on host drivers and probes; setup does not download models or start services.

name: croc
notes: Encrypted file transfer; Arch extra repo. Transfers require network access and can use public relays; protect transfer codes. No relay or automatic transfers are configured.

name: grex
notes: Generates regular expressions from examples; Arch extra repo. Review generated expressions for unintended matches and target-engine compatibility.

name: kondo
notes: CLI for deleting project dependencies and build artifacts; Arch extra repo. Cleanup is destructive and must be invoked explicitly by the user; setup never runs it or installs kondo-ui.

name: Worktrunk
notes: Git worktree manager exposed as wt; Arch extra repo. Requires Git and conflicts with wiredtiger's wt executable. Shell integration, project hooks, agent plugins, and LLM providers are not configured.

name: atuin
notes: Shell history sync and search; Arch extra repo. `atuin register`/`atuin login` to sync across machines is a manual, credential-bearing step this setup never runs.

name: glow
notes: Terminal Markdown renderer; Arch extra repo.

name: d2
notes: Declarative diagram scripting language; no official Arch package, AUR d2-bin is an actively maintained prebuilt binary.

name: gcalcli
notes: Google Calendar command-line interface; no official Arch package, AUR gcalcli is actively maintained. First run requires your own Google OAuth setup; no credentials are configured by this setup.
